detail.title: WAKE Research Proposal: Continuity Simulation Refinement
detail.summary: Advancing project-continuity-rationale by replacing static mock evaluations with a controlled Python-based agent simulation to rigorously measure reward variance under variable non-stationarity, testing the hypothesis that goal continuity provides an instrumental advantage.
